description: HTTPGetAction describes an action based on HTTP Get requests.

host.description: host is the host name to connect to, defaults to the pod IP. You probably want to set "Host" in httpHeaders instead.

httpHeaders.description: httpHeaders are the custom headers to set in the request. HTTP allows repeated headers.

items.description: HTTPHeader describes a custom header to be used in HTTP probes

name.description: name is the header field name. This will be canonicalized upon output, so case-variant names will be understood as the same header.

value.description: value is the header field value

path.description: path is the path to access on the HTTP server.

protocol.description: protocol selects the wire protocol for the probe connection. Nil defaults to HTTP/1.1.

scheme.description: scheme is the scheme to use for connecting to the host. Defaults to HTTP.
